name: Todo
description: A todo list used to demonstrate editors that receive their document and dispatch as props

operations.name: ADD_ITEM
operations.reducer: state.items.push({ id: action.input.id, title: action.input.title, checked: false });

operations.name: CHECK_ITEM
operations.reducer:
const item = state.items.find((i) => i.id === action.input.id);
if (item) item.checked = action.input.checked;
